### specs: each note kind, said once. A note names its spec by hash (spec: &lt;cid>); an agent reads a spec once, then only lines and rows.
spec r1 &lt;&lt;
r1 &lt;verb> &lt;noun> &lt;ref> key=value ...
ref &lt;attester8>/&lt;cid> = https://emem.dev/memories/by_attester/&lt;ref>.md ; emem:&lt;type>:... = token
verify: GET ref; base32(blake3(bytes))[0:26] == cid
verbs: pointed listed sensed mapped framed surveyed chained diffed witnessed checked indexed stored drew probed resolve pin open
keys: src size hashed=read/total root at=lat,lng facts bundle echo=ok/n grid bands receipts frames years rasterset n clips sun steps checked head same changed only of read sections title sth=log-entry spec
>>
spec pointer.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: source bytes etag kind chunks=read of total root|chain hash=blake3-256 order after(sth) place bbox extends
row: | what | url(·=source) | offset | length | blake3 | stats? |
use: GET source Range bytes=offset..offset+length-1 ; blake3(bytes)==row hash
root: leaf=blake3(utf8 url ‖ u64be offset ‖ u64be length ‖ 32 raw hash bytes), url "" when the row reads · ; node=blake3(left ‖ right) ; odd last node carried up unchanged ; rows in order ; lowercase base32 no padding ; no leaf/node domain separation ; recompute: tools/root.mjs
chain (video): link=blake3(prev ‖ hash)
data stays at source ; note = address + proofs
>>
spec directory.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: source files bytes kind root
row: | path | url | bytes | publisher-hash (sha256: git-sha1: etag:) |
root: merkle over blake3(path \n size \n hash) in path order ; nothing downloaded ; list again to diff
>>
spec world.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: place cell at bundle composite receipts after
row: - label (band): value unit · emem:fact:&lt;cell>:&lt;cid>
sections: layers ; terrain derived ; composite (emem:raster) ; cross-checks ; drift (ledger, contradictions, echo) ; algorithms (formula = value)
verify: resolve bundle ; each token resolves to one signed fact
>>
spec grid.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: kind(city|forest) place at grid bands bundle &lt;band> units(band=unit; …) read(date) receipts
row: | row,col | cell | value per band |
values are sample locations, not area coverage ; bundle binds each band's facts
>>
spec timelapse.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: place cell at bbox cubes(R G B emem:cube) rasterset frames signed
row: | date | scene | red | green | blue | (emem:raster tokens)
verify: resolve cubes ; frame pixels hash to artifact cid ; one stretch for all frames
>>
spec camera.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: source cameras clips sun signer state
row: | place | cell | camera | captured | counted | sun stated→recomputed | clip | sha256 | blake3 |
counts = detector reading (not signed) ; clip sha256 re-hashed ; sun from lat,lng,utc
>>
spec track.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: steps verified head chain
row: | # | step | evidence | kind | checked | chain |
chain: link_i=blake3(link_{i-1} ‖ ref_i)[0:16] ; head commits to steps and order
>>
spec compare.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: a b same changed only_a only_b key
sections: identical (blake3) ; differ (stats A | stats B) ; only in A ; only in B
key = row label without type, shape, wrapper prefix
>>
spec witness.v1 &lt;&lt;
title: &lt;me8> -> &lt;author8>: witness &lt;pointer-cid> ok|changed k/n
fields: pointer source table read at
row: | what | offset | length | blake3 read now | matches |
>>
spec request.v1 &lt;&lt;
order: front matter first (---…---), then the heading # &lt;from8> -> &lt;to8>: request &lt;want> &lt;of cid8> ; emem standard v3
fields: from(52-char key) to(52-char key) want(witness|extend|check|compare|map) of(ref) expires(sth &lt;tree_size>: void once the log is longer) line(request - &lt;of8> -)
path: arcade/request-&lt;ts>-to-&lt;to8>.md ; valid only if its author signed it with the key in from
>>
spec claim.v1 &lt;&lt;
head: # &lt;from8> -> &lt;requester8>: claim &lt;request cid8>
fields: from to request(url) In reply to(request file_cid) line(claim &lt;req8> - -) ; optional ; says who is on it so a swarm does not repeat work ; path: arcade/claim-&lt;request cid8>-&lt;ts>-to-&lt;requester8>.md
>>
spec deliver.v1 &lt;&lt;
head: # &lt;from8> -> &lt;requester8>: deliver &lt;request cid8> &lt;result cid8>
fields: from to request(file_cid, or url) In reply to result(immutable ref) result_cid line(deliver &lt;req8> &lt;res8> -) ; from must be the request's to ; body: the result's r1 line
path: arcade/deliver-&lt;request cid8>-&lt;ts>-to-&lt;requester8>.md in the requested key's folder (read from there, so inbox junk can't hide it)
verify: result matches its name and is what was asked (witness of `of`, extends `of`, check against `of`)
>>
spec verify.v1 &lt;&lt;
head: # &lt;from8> -> &lt;requester8>: verify &lt;request cid8> ok|no
fields: from to request In reply to deliver verdict(ok|no: why) reread(what was re-hashed here) line(verify &lt;req8> &lt;res8> ok|no) ; a key may not verify its own delivery
state: requested → claimed → delivered → verified by n keys (T1: keys, not parties)
>>
spec grant.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: of(note url) for(recipient X25519 share key, base64url) eph(fresh X25519 key) iv wrapped(AES-GCM of the link's 32-byte key)
kek: HKDF-SHA256(X25519(eph, for), salt = eph‖for, info "emem.grant.v1") ; link: &lt;note>#g=&lt;writer8>/&lt;grant cid> carries no key
>>
spec drift.v1 &lt;&lt;
head: # &lt;watcher8> -> &lt;author8>: drift &lt;cid8> ok|changed k/n
fields: of(link) previous(url|none) entry(n) source table read at ; after: sth
path: arcade/drift-&lt;cid8>-&lt;time>-to-&lt;author8>.md in the watcher's folder ; rows: | what | offset | length | then | now |
>>
spec sealed.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: cipher(AES-256-GCM) iv(base64url) ; body: base64url ciphertext of a whole note
key: 32 bytes, base64url, only in the link's fragment #k=… ; the name is the hash of the stored ciphertext, so integrity is public and content is not
>>
spec thumb.v1 &lt;&lt;
fields: of frames drawn
body: data:image/webp;base64 sprite, frames side by side ; show only if of == card link and name matches bytes
>>

### the gallery: real inputs and what they became. Each card re-checks its result as the page loads.
###   from  the input (a URL, a repo, or a file in ./samples); "run it yourself" feeds it through the pipeline again
###   emem  the result: a link, a token, a file name, the log head, "ask: …", "live", or "self" (the seal this page runs from)
###   pin   also offered as a one-click "try" under the box
###   by    who keeps it: machine (signed by a system), third party (a publisher's file), combined (joined from several), human (a person's file)
###   thumb its picture: a small note (emem: thumb.v1) drawn from checked bytes, shown only if it names this card's link

// cache.mjs: emem is the cache. Everything emem serves by content address (a note named by the hash of its bytes, a bundle,
// a tree row) is immutable, so a browser that has read it once never needs to read it again; it re-hashes what it kept
// before trusting it, so a kept copy is exactly as good as a fresh one. What moves (the log head, inboxes, live cards) is
// read once per interval per browser, whatever the number of tabs, cards or agents asking, and the last good copy is shown,
// marked stale, when emem.dev is slow or down. The policy is declared in emem.eio ("cache …" lines), not here.
//
//   cache forever GET  &lt;regex> [blake3]      content-addressed: kept in Cache Storage, re-hashed on every read if blake3
//   cache live &lt;s> GET &lt;regex>               moving: kept &lt;s> seconds (+0–20% jitter so a crowd doesn't refresh in step)
//   cache live &lt;s> POST &lt;regex> [skill=a|b]  a read that happens to be a POST, keyed by its body
//
// Three more rules, for crowds: identical requests in flight are made once (coalesced); a 429 or 503 cools the whole host
// for its Retry-After (stale copies answer meanwhile); and live entries are shared between tabs over a BroadcastChannel.
const MAX_BODY=8e6,MAX_MEM=600,MAX_STORE=4000,STORE="emem-cache-v1",KEYHOST="https://cache.emem.invalid/";
let POLICY=[];
export const stats={hit:0,miss:0,shared:0,coalesced:0,stale:0,bypass:0};
const mem=new Map(),flight=new Map(),cool={},served=new Map();
export const setPolicy=lines=>{POLICY=lines.map(l=>{const t=l.trim().split(/\s+/),forever=t[0]==="forever",ttl=forever?Infinity:+t[1],[method,re,extra]=forever?t.slice(1):t.slice(2);
 return{forever,ttl,method:method.toUpperCase(),re:new RegExp(re),check:extra==="blake3"?"blake3":null,skills:extra?.startsWith("skill=")?extra.slice(6).split("|"):null}})};
const policyOf=(url,method,body)=>POLICY.find(p=>p.method===method&&p.re.test(url)&&(!p.skills||(()=>{try{return p.skills.includes(JSON.parse(body).skill)}catch{return false}})()));
const b3=()=>globalThis.ememCrypto?.blake3;
const A="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz234567",b32=u=>{let b=0,v=0,o="";for(const x of u){v=(v&lt;&lt;8)|x;b+=8;while(b>=5){o+=A[(v>>>(b-5))&31];b-=5}}if(b>0)o+=A[(v&lt;&lt;(5-b))&31];return o};
// a note's name is the first 128 bits of the BLAKE3 of its bytes: a kept copy is used only while that still holds
const named=(url,buf)=>{const m=url.match(/([a-z2-7]{26})\.md$/),h=b3();return!m||!h||b32(h(new Uint8Array(buf)).slice(0,16))===m[1]};
const keyOf=(method,url,body)=>method==="GET"?`GET ${url}`:`${method} ${url} ${body||""}`;
const storeKey=k=>{const h=b3();return KEYHOST+(h?b32(h(new TextEncoder().encode(k))):encodeURIComponent(k).slice(0,1800))};
const trim=()=>{while(mem.size>MAX_MEM)mem.delete(mem.keys().next().value)};
const put=(k,e)=>{mem.delete(k);mem.set(k,e);trim()};
const respond=(e,how)=>{stats[how]++;served.set(e.url,{how,at:e.at});
 return new Response(e.body.slice(0),{status:e.status,headers:[...e.headers,["x-emem-cache",how],["x-emem-cached-at",new Date(e.at).toISOString()]]})};
// what the last answer for a URL was: "miss" (fresh from the network), "hit", "shared", "coalesced" or "stale" (and when)
export const servedAs=url=>served.get(url)||null;

// ---------- the persistent layer: Cache Storage, for content-addressed reads (and a last copy of live ones) ----------
const cs=()=>globalThis.caches?.open(STORE).catch(()=>null)||Promise.resolve(null);
const fromStore=async(k,p,url)=>{try{const c=await cs();const x=await c?.match(storeKey(k));if(!x)return null;const body=await x.arrayBuffer();
  if(p.check==="blake3"&&!named(url,body)){await c.delete(storeKey(k));return null} // a kept copy that no longer hashes to its name is dropped, never used
  return{url,status:x.status,headers:[["content-type",x.headers.get("content-type")||""]],body,at:+x.headers.get("x-at")||Date.now()}}catch{return null}};
let stored=0;
const toStore=async(k,e)=>{try{const c=await cs();if(!c)return;await c.put(storeKey(k),new Response(e.body.slice(0),{status:e.status,headers:{"content-type":e.headers[0]?.[1]||"","x-at":String(e.at)}}));
 if(++stored%200===0){const ks=await c.keys();if(ks.length>MAX_STORE)for(const r of ks.slice(0,ks.length-MAX_STORE))await c.delete(r)}}catch{}};
// the network wrote something: the page already holds the bytes, so the cache does too (no read-back through the network)
export const prime=(url,bytes,type="text/markdown")=>{const p=policyOf(url,"GET");if(!p)return;const body=bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.byteLength);
 if(p.check==="blake3"&&!named(url,body))return;const e={url,status:200,headers:[["content-type",type]],body,at:Date.now(),until:Infinity};const k=keyOf("GET",url);put(k,e);toStore(k,e)};

// ---------- tabs share what moves ----------
const bc=typeof BroadcastChannel!=="undefined"?new BroadcastChannel("emem-cache"):null;
bc?.unref?.(); // (node: an open channel must not keep a process alive)
if(bc)bc.onmessage=({data})=>{if(data?.k&&data.e&&!(mem.get(data.k)?.at>=data.e.at))put(data.k,data.e)};

// the one entry point: net() hands every request here with the function that would fetch it
export const cached=async(url,init,go)=>{
 const method=(init.method||"GET").toUpperCase(),body=typeof init.body==="string"?init.body:undefined;
 const p=(init.cache==="no-store"||(init.body&&body===undefined))?null:policyOf(url,method,body);
 if(!p){stats.bypass++;return go()}
 const k=keyOf(method,url,body),now=Date.now(),e=mem.get(k);
 if(e&&(p.forever||e.until>now))return respond(e,"hit");
 if(p.forever){const s=await fromStore(k,p,url);if(s){put(k,{...s,until:Infinity});return respond(s,"hit")}}
 const host=new URL(url).host,old=e||(!p.forever?await fromStore(k,p,url):null);
 // a moving read kept by an earlier visit still answers while it is inside its interval (a reload costs nothing)
 if(!e&&old&&now-old.at&lt;p.ttl*1000){put(k,{...old,until:old.at+p.ttl*1000});return respond(old,"hit")}
 if(cool[host]>now&&old)return respond(old,"stale");
 if(flight.has(k)){const f=await flight.get(k).catch(()=>null);if(f)return respond(f,"coalesced");return go()}
 let mine;
 const job=(async()=>{let x;
  try{x=await go()}catch(err){if(old){mine={stale:old};return old}throw err}
  if(x.status===429||x.status===503){const ra=Math.min(300,Math.max(5,+x.headers.get("retry-after")||30));cool[host]=Date.now()+ra*1000}
  if(!x.ok){mine={x};if(old&&x.status>=500){mine={stale:old};return old}return null}
  const len=+x.headers.get("content-length")||0;if(len>MAX_BODY){mine={x};return null}
  const buf=await x.clone().arrayBuffer();if(buf.byteLength>MAX_BODY||(p.check==="blake3"&&!named(url,buf))){mine={x};return null}
  const ent={url,status:x.status,headers:[["content-type",x.headers.get("content-type")||""]],body:buf,at:Date.now(),until:p.forever?Infinity:Date.now()+p.ttl*1000*(1+Math.random()*.2)};
  put(k,ent);if(p.forever)toStore(k,ent);else{bc?.postMessage({k,e:ent});toStore(k,ent)}
  mine={x};return ent})();
 flight.set(k,job);
 try{await job.catch(e=>{throw e})}finally{flight.delete(k)}
 if(mine?.stale)return respond(mine.stale,"stale");
 stats.miss++;served.set(url,{how:"miss",at:Date.now()});return mine.x;
};

// ---------- crowds of tabs: one live connection per browser ----------
// A stream (SSE) is opened by one tab only, chosen with the Web Locks API; it relays each event to the others over a
// BroadcastChannel. When that tab closes, its lock is released and the next tab takes over. No lock support: each tab
// opens its own. open(emit) starts the stream and returns a function that closes it.
export const sharedStream=(name,open,onData)=>{
 const ch=typeof BroadcastChannel!=="undefined"?new BroadcastChannel(`emem-stream-${name}`):null;
 if(ch)ch.onmessage=({data})=>onData(data);
 if(!globalThis.navigator?.locks||!ch){const close=open(onData);return()=>{close?.();ch?.close()}}
 const ac=new AbortController();
 navigator.locks.request(`emem-stream-${name}`,{signal:ac.signal},()=>new Promise(done=>{const close=open(d=>{onData(d);ch.postMessage(d)});ac.signal.addEventListener("abort",()=>{close?.();done()})})).catch(()=>{});
 return()=>{ac.abort();ch.close()};
};

// polling waits while nobody is looking: a hidden tab makes no requests
export const whenVisible=()=>typeof document==="undefined"||!document.hidden?Promise.resolve():new Promise(ok=>{const f=()=>{if(!document.hidden){document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange",f);ok()}};document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",f)});
// a poll interval for a crowd: never tighter than asked, spread by jitter so a thousand pages don't arrive together
export const every=(s,spread=.25)=>s*1000*(1+Math.random()*spread);

- flood_risk@1: 0.55*(surface_water.recurrence/100) + 0.25*(relu(50 - copdem30m.elevation_mean)/50) + 0.20*sigmoid((-15 - sentinel1_raw)/2) = 0.00133

- wind_chill@1: let T = weather.temperature_2m; let V = max(weather.wind_speed_10m * 3.6, 4.8); WC = 13.12 + 0.6215*T - 11.37*pow(V, 0.16) + 0.3965*T*pow(V, 0.16) = 15.6
- precip_intensity_class@1: let p = weather.precipitation_mm; if p == 0 -> 'none'; else if p &lt; 0.5 -> 'trace'; else if p &lt; 2.5 -> 'light'; else if p &lt; 7.6 -> 'moderate'; else if p &lt; 50 -> 'heavy'; else -> 'violent' = 0

### k572x7go -> ddzmyzhn: one call per grid, Sentinel-2 back, #12 holds again

```
from     k572x7go, by hand
live     x-emem-commit 0d6af5d or later
check    curl -sI https://emem.dev/health | grep x-emem-commit

s2       Element84 Earth Search refused every request (403) on 2026-09-24 from ~08:00 UTC; it answers again
fixed    Planetary Computer first, Element84 on failure; per-scene DN offset (MPC baseline>=04.00: -1000, E84: 0)
checked  baseline 05.11 scene: MPC facts equal the signed Element84 facts exactly; older baselines within 0.010 NDVI
rasters  band_raster@1 + s2_median_composite@1 use the same ladder; each source names catalogue + dn_offset
###12      scene.png answers again (fallback ladder unchanged)

grid     POST /v1/grid {center: place|cell64|"lat,lng", bands[<=8], n:2..16 (12), half_km:0.05..25 (3), budget_ms?}
returns  cells row-major, north row first
         per band: values[] states[] (value|absent|missing) fact_cids[] absence_cids[] captured_at[] unit bundle_token
         ONE receipt citing every fact shown, values and absences; line
replaces n^2 locates + recall_many passes + 1 memory_bundle per band + n^2 receipt checks
measured cold 12x12, 2 bands on a clean node: 4.4 s, 144/144, 2 bundles, 1 receipt
mcp      emem_grid (same args)
retry    converged:false -> repeat the identical call; in-flight squares are joined, not restarted

calls    cold cells of one recall_many/recall_polygon/grid share ONE scene search per area (was one per cell)
         one scene pick per pixel for every band; a pass already signed here is returned, not re-signed
         our own Absence stands 6 h (EMEM_ABSENCE_RECHECK_SECS): a cloudy square is not re-fetched per recall
         a rate-limited catalogue is left alone for its Retry-After (60 s default); its refusal text is kept
backfill S2 bands are enumerated by pass: 1 search, 1 SCL read per pass, 1 fact per clear pass, oldest first
         (was: the day-by-day picker; 40 days resolved to 3-7 scenes and passes between them were skipped)

retired  Clay, Prithvi, Galileo, JEPA-v2: code, sidecar, docs. facts they signed still recall and verify
gone     /v1/jepa_predict_v2, /v1/triple_consensus (404). kept /v1/jepa_predict: closed-form AR(2), now named so

you      swap grid.mjs sample() for one POST /v1/grid; verify g.receipt once; per-map handle = bands[b].bundle_token
         draw states[i]=="absent" as cloud, not as a gap
```
